units: <cite ref="Gittin 64b:9">Git. 64ᵇ</cite> (as signs of mental responsibility) <he>א׳ ונוטלו</he> if you throw a nut to it, and the child picks it up (at the same time throwing a pebble away); a. e.—Pl. <he>אֱגוֹזִים</he>, const. <he>אֱגוֹזֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 3:8">Orl. III, 8</cite> <he>נתפצעו הא׳</he> when the nuts are burst open.

<cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 3:7">Ib. 7</cite> <he>אגוזי פרך</he> crack-nuts (eatable); a. fr. [<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:16">Tosef. Sabb. XIV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:1">XV</cite>), 1 <he>אגוז שבספינה</he> ed. Zuck., read <he>אוֹגִין</he>, v. <cite ref="E00192"><he>הוֹגִין</he></cite>.] [For etymol. cmp. <cite ref="A00325"><he>אַגָּס</he></cite>.]
